text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday afternoon.
As I happened to be passing by a park—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Hit the dirt!!
choice_data_list: Wh-What's going on all of a sudden?!
Wh-What's all this about out of nowhere?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's sudden battle cry
made me flinch in surprise.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey you, daydream and you're caught in the crossfire!
Danger! Danger!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh, looks like there ain't a safe haven in sight around here...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Golshi, we can't advance any further!
Let's fall back to the Jungle Gym Fortress!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: B-But we have to cross that sandbox full of molten lava to get back...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Trainer, haul your tail over here too!
If worst comes to worst, my Gol-Gol Kempo will split the earth in two...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Gold Ship was playing pretend with the local kids.
Before I knew it, I'd been roped right into the middle of it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! That's the lava zone right there!
Where the heck are you lookin' while you walk?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't try to see it, feel it!
Don't think, feeel! Ain't you my trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright minions, let's roll!
This Golshi-chan will bring up the rear!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Just leave your backs to me... Heh, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! You're so cool, Big Sis Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, led along by a fully immersed Gold Ship and the kids,
I set out to cross the sandbox, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sis Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right in the middle of the sandbox, Gold Ship suddenly collapsed!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Looks like I'm a goner...
To think I'd get taken out in a place like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You guys... even without me... carry on... be strong...!
—*slump*

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: No way... Open your eyes, Big Sis Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—The crime scene is a locked room. The murder weapon is nowhere to be found.
Every single suspect has an ironclad alibi.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the case'll go unsolved forever.
But don't you worry... leave it to Great Detective Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Boys
text_block_list.text: There she is! It's Great Detective Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! Mmmh! Mmmmmh!
—My emerald brain cells with an IQ of 5.64 million just had a Gol-flash.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The culprit who shot me is... YOU, you bastard!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship pointed right at me!
As I stood there at a loss for words—

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: You gotta say something back, or you're gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! You're Big Sis Golshi's trainer, right?
Show us something cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see... Rather than just being dragged around, maybe I should just
turn off my brain and play along at full throttle like these kids...?!
choice_data_list: That's right! Everyone here, prepare yourselves...!
That is correct! Every last one of you, prepare yourselves...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guh, you finally revealed your true colors...!
The thirty purple tentacles sproutin' from your head are definitive proof!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But we're no match for that monster as we are now!
Fall back, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...!
To think you'd chase us this far...!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: What do we do... We're cornered...?!
choice_data_list: This is the end of the line for you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hah, but which of us is really the one cornered—?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am Golucia, the Goddess of Horsegirls.
To you gentle-hearted souls, I shall bestow divine power.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: It's Golucia, the goddess who performs 100 miracles a year!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! You guys should be feelin' it surgind through you now too!
The divine power of the Horsegirl Goddess...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true!
I feel totally invincible now...!
choice_data_list: Could it be... Horsegirl Goddess Power?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Darn right it is!
Our current power level is sitting at a whopping 5.64 million...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There's no way we'd lose to the likes of you!
Get ready! Taste the wrath of Golshi-chan's vengeance—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Justice—PREVAILS!!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Hooray! That was awesome, Big Sis Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had absolutely no idea what just happened...
but rolling with Gold Ship's nonsense was surprisingly fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! Mission accomplished, totally nailed it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Park peace was preserved, the culprit was caught,
Golshi-chan became a god, and all conflict was wiped from the earth!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Plus flowers bloomed, trees flourished,
and the birds burst into song! As expected of the Great Golshi-sama~!
choice_data_list: The kids had a blast too.
The kids really enjoyed it too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
'Course they did! Like I'd ever do anything
boring for even a tenth of a second!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Besides, your vibe today wasn't half-bad either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like today, and today only,
I finally learned how to keep up with Gold Ship...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Time to go finish drawing the Nazca Lines I started on the schoolyard yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You come along too! Meet me there in three seconds! Later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
............
Yeah, maybe it'll still take a while before I can truly keep up with her!
